text:
anika: Heads up — quick sync on minimal/offline install presets for private deployments. Need to lock presets by EOW. TL;DR: customers want tiny footprint + predictable in-place upgrades.

sam: Which presets are we proposing? minimal / standard / enterprise?

anika: Yes. Minimal = single-node runtime with telemetry off by default; Standard = HA control plane + optional metrics; Enterprise = KMS/HSM integrations + multi-tenancy operator. Need exact default knobs.

raj: FYI customers (FinCorp, MediApps) specifically asked for 'no cloud deps' and "installer < 30min" in their contracts.

priya: They also want customer-managed networking options: bridge-mode (host networking), sidecar-router (our lightweight edge), and passthrough VPN. We need a clear compatibility matrix + supported fallbacks.

sam: Upgrade path Q: can minimal -> standard be done online or does it require data migration + maintenance window?

anika: Goal is in-place upgrade minimal->standard without bulk copy. Operator should scale control plane replicas and enable HA; KV migration should be streaming/rolling. Need an acceptance test plan.

raj: Proposed acceptance: start with minimal config, run sustained traffic ~1 rps for 24h, perform staged upgrade, verify zero token-loss and <2x latency spike for median.

priya: NetOps asks: IP preservation across upgrades. If NAT/public IPs change we break cert pinning & whitelists. Proposal: stable cluster ID + cert rotation hook + guidance for IP-preserving NAT rules.

sam: Fallback plan: if upgrade fails, automatic rollback using a snapshot. Suggest: create pre-upgrade snapshot + monitor health; if critical checks fail within 10 minutes, rollback.

anika: Draft launch criteria: installer success rate >95% on curated lab hardware (small/medium/large), installer runtime <30m for minimal, <90m for standard, automated upgrade rollback completes in <15m.

raj: Perf gates: minimal runtime must handle 200 qps for an 8-token prompt on T4-equivalent; standard should be >1k qps. We'll pin benchmark vectors in the repo.

priya: I'll build a network matrix doc with allowed combos and known limitations. For field cases where NetOps blocks outbound, include an offline license activation flow and manual cert injection steps.

sam: Recommend exposing presets via CLI and config file: `redwood-installer --preset=minimal --skip-telemetry --network=sidecar`. Also produce a JSON/YAML preset artifact for config-as-code.

sam: Example minimal preset snippet: 
```yaml
preset: minimal
replicas: 1
telemetry: false
autoscale: false
network_mode: host-bridge
quantization: q4_0
```

devx-bot: deploy-bot: created issue #4123 "installer-presets: minimal/standard/enterprise" and assigned to @anika @sam

anika: Priority = P0 for customers currently blocked. Putting this on next sprint if eng-runtime can commit a small spike for streaming KV migration.

raj: Can we commit autoscaling off by default in minimal to keep predictability and easier rollback surface?

priya: Yes — minimal defaults: single GPU, autoscale disabled, quantized runtime enabled, telemetry opt-in.

sam: Action items: 1) PM: finalize presets YAML (anika) 2) Eng-runtime: implement migration hooks + automated rollback (sam + eng-runtime) 3) DevX: CLI flags + install docs + offline activation flow (priya) 4) QA: acceptance harness + perf runs (raj).

anika: I'll run a stakeholder sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to confirm scope & owners. Ping me if a milestone slips. :thumbsup:
